reviews.author: Joi P.
reviews.title: I hate the applicator
reviews.body: The color is pretty I don't know if I'm a fan of the tubing if that's what makes it kind of flaky after I only worn it for like an hour I feel like things are getting in my eyes maybe I'm just not used to the tubing I don't know but I cannot stand this applicator spoolie thing ugh I hate those hard little applicators I prefer a traditional old school mascara wand otherwise I think it's pretty color and it seemed to last until I washed it off so I guess if I would recommend it it would be to somebody that doesn't have sensitive eyes that maybe is used to this kind of mascara and doesn't mind a really hard applicator

fields.Skin Concerns: Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Dryness, Uneven Skin

reviews.author: Amanda N.
reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.body: Package and color are great! However, it's too clumpy and flaky. By the end of the day, I've got mascara flakes around my eyes. Would not purchase again.

fields.Skin Concerns: Visible Pores, Uneven Skin, Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Oil Control

reviews.author: Kristin H.
reviews.title: Black only
reviews.body:
I have used this product for many years. I recently got the green color and let me tell you. Don’t waste your money. Colored mascara just looks black. I wasted my money getting/trying green. 
I will not however use any other brand. I LOVE how it stays on but it a comes off so easily. 

I would love to have given this 5 stars but I’m terribly disappointed about the way the green didn’t turn out. I guess I essentially have two black mascaras which I would have eventually bought again anyways.

reviews.author: Alison M.
reviews.title: Really want this to work.
reviews.body: I have had lash extensions for years nd it was recommended that I try the tubing mascara as I transition off of them. The tubing mascara seems to come off in hunks for days and gets everywhere. I hope I can get better at using it and I hope it is the right product for me. So far, not so good. I wouldn’t recommend it yet.

reviews.author: Elsa R.
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.body: I was really excited to try this product after seeing the ad, the model’s eyes looked so pretty with the light maroon shade. However, on me, it looks like any other brown mascara. I don’t see the light maroon color shown in the ad, but I do like that it doesn’t run.

reviews.author: Sharon A.
reviews.title: This color did not work
reviews.body: This color did not work for me!

reviews.author: Valerie M.
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.body: The color is nice and it washes off easily. No clumping but not easy to use on lower lashes . Overall, its ok. I continue the hunt for the mascara of old .

reviews.author: Rosemary B.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: The length is noticeably longer, I am trying different techniques I am getting clumps and lashes stuck together. I would prefer more defined separations between lashes . I like that this washes off with out much effort . I wonder if I needed a lighter color

reviews.author: Katrina K.
reviews.title: It’s only okay.
reviews.body: Not impressed. Tarte is better.

reviews.author: Karen T.
reviews.title: Works, but....
reviews.body: Definitely does lengthen, but does also glop a bit going on, even with a light touch. Had to find an old brush to separate my lashes

reviews.author: Tiffany T.
reviews.title: It's okay for a natural lash
reviews.body: I tried both the purple and berry brown. I'm used to another brand of tube mascara that really enhances my lashes. However, the applicator on this one makes it give a much more natural/thin vs voluminous look. So, for me, it's 3 stars. But for someone who likes a minimalistic lash, you will like this. Another caveat: this tube mascara actually flakes quite a bit throughout the day. My other brand doesn't do that at all, unless I sleep on it. So just something to consider, especially for the price point.

reviews.author: Stacey S.
reviews.title: Shipping Fail
reviews.body:
Was excited to try the plum/purple
Mascara from a friend recommendation. New customer discount! Yay I was excited! Then week goes by, then another. Still in “label created” status. Finally got a hold of someone and they reshipped priority. Still took full business week. No coupon or anything for waiting 2 weeks. Wasn’t even offered. Stated, priority shipping was enough. Prolly order from anyone else after my initial impression. Mascara is good, but for not good enough for the hassle; didn’t make my eyes “pop” as described. Washed off really well as a positive! I’d recommend using another brand.

reviews.author: Roberta M.
reviews.title: Nice enough, but rather difficult
reviews.body: Nice enough, but rather difficult to remove, sorry to say! I like your other products better, and I need to look elsewhere for mascara!

reviews.author: KW
reviews.title: New Formulation? No longer works well
reviews.body: I’ve used this mascara exclusively for years. The newest one I received does *not* work like it used to. It takes a million coats to get any kind of coverage and clumps up in chunks rather than the easy to apply, old experience. What changed? I’m sad to have to find a new brand.

reviews.author: Sharon W.
reviews.title: Color not as expected
reviews.body: Color not as expected. Looks black

reviews.author: Nancy L.
reviews.title: It’s ok. I prefer a
reviews.body: It’s ok. I prefer a curved mascara wand and this doesn’t have one.

reviews.author: Dj E.
reviews.title: Works if you have enough lashes
reviews.body: They did separate my lashes but I guess you can’t wrap tubes around lashes that are not there. They didn’t look that different from my regular thrive mascara, but it’s ok- not your products fault and they did come off easy.

reviews.author: Carol
reviews.title: Why??
reviews.body:
Why are all the models you use to advertise your mascara already have long lashes?
Why Don't You Post People Who Are Lacking Long Or Abundant Lashes?
That's Where You Would Bring Many More customers.

reviews.author: Katie C.
reviews.title: The packaging is nice and
reviews.body: The packaging is nice and it comes off pretty easily a little messy in the sink though and seems to clump when applying.

reviews.author: Kathy D.
reviews.title: I used to really like this mascara
reviews.body: I have used this mascara but hadn’t bought any new ones in a while because I stocked up when there was a sale. But I must say when I purchased it this time it’s not as good. I don’t know if it changed formulas or what but the way it used to make my lashes long was wonderful. Now it’s not nearly as good. Doesn’t make my lashes as long. Comes off easily, but the staying power is not as good. Super disappointed and I don’t think I will buy it again

fields.Skin Concerns: Puffiness, Visible Pores, Fine Lines + Wrinkles

reviews.author: Andrea M.

reviews.body: These are not bad. I have other tubing mascara that I like more, and maybe it's just because I got colors and not black that I feel like my other mascara does a better job, but I do appreciate that it doesn't flake or smudge at all when I'm wearing it.

reviews.author: Maryanne H.

reviews.author: Jennifer G.

reviews.author: KM
reviews.title: color doesn't pop
reviews.body: This was my first purchase from Thrive cosmetics. I think the packaging is really nice, the formula seems like a good tubing mascara (it lengthens lashes and comes off easily). But, the colors like ivy, berry brown and iris don't pop at all. They look like any other black or brown mascara out there. I don't see the color...or the hype.

reviews.author: Sarah F.
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body: Another product I was really looking forward to only to be let down especially at the price paid. Don’t get me wrong the color is great and the ability to make my lashes lifted is nice. What I don’t like is if my make up wipe doesn’t fully remove the mascara night then I am left with dried mascara on my eyelashes that makes my eyes gunky. I’ll have thick pieces of leftover mascara pulling off my lashes and sprinkled on my eyelids and cheeks. Just not something I normally have to deal with when using other mascara brands.

reviews.author: Jammie S.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: Mascara is just ok. They mascara that I have been using is much better. But they do not come in as many colors that you offer.

reviews.body: I use the tubing mascara, but the green is not as dark as I’d like so it is just ok.

reviews.author: Jennifer B.
reviews.title: Great for sensitive eyes but very hard to remove.
reviews.body: It has very little to no flaking. But is extremely hard to remove. I can get my other mascara off with just my microfiber cloths and even easier with eye makeup remover liquids but this one comes off flaky and chunky and actually gets into my eye and sticks to my lower inner eyelids and causing me to have to pull on my skin around my eye multiple times to take it all off. I love that it doesn't make my eyes burn or sting while wearing it but once it gets inside my eye when taking it off it does of course. Their other mascara is super flaky. I wish there was an in-between.

reviews.author: Valentina
reviews.title: Unfortunately it dries sooo fast
reviews.body: Have to order it way more often than any other mascara :(

reviews.author: Emily S.
reviews.title: Clumps
reviews.body: I wanted to like this so much, but it keeps clumping my eyelashes which is not the effect I’m going for.

reviews.author: Frankie S.
reviews.title: This mascara was recommended but
reviews.body: This mascara was recommended but it did not give me the length I was looking for

reviews.author: Angelica D.
reviews.title: Mid
reviews.body:
Pros: Dark Black, adds length
Cons: Micro Flakes, does not hold a curl for straight lash girlies.

I was optimistic because it said "waterproof". For straight lash girls you know Waterproof is the only formula that [should] hold a curl. I found out this one does not. So I have to use another waterproof mascara that I know will hold a curl and add Thrive for added bold black look. It's mid & wouldn't purchase again since I'm having to use 2 products for the [what I had hoped] work of one. Was looking to try something new since they changed the formula on my other trusted mascara that still holds a curl but not as waterproof as before and not as dark black as before.

reviews.author: Vicky A.

reviews.author: Julie A.
reviews.title: Less than impressed
reviews.body: It's ok, I wish the purple showed a little more

reviews.author: Jessica M.
reviews.title: Totally fine!
reviews.body: I've been getting ads for this mascara for literally years, and finally tried it. I have short eyelashes and sensitive eyes, and I was hoping this one would be different. Unfortunately, it still made my eyes burn a bit, and turned out really clumpy for me. It was a totally fine mascara, but I didn't notice a huge difference between this one and my $7 one from Target unfortunately. I wanted so much to love it!

reviews.author: Victoria S.
reviews.title: It’s ok

reviews.title: Disappointed

I really wanted to love this mascara, my eyelashes seemed to be thinning out and it promised to help build and lengthen. However, it does no better job than my $7. 00 Maybelline mascara. It was also a lighter color than the black/brown label indicated. 

This is the second time I've been disappointed by one of this company's products: the Sheer Strength lip gloss was also not as expected, it was not at all moisturizing, nor did it have a gloss tint effect.

I will say the brilliant eye brightened is, in fact, brilliant and wonderful--I love it. I don't want to seem like nothing has worked well for me!

reviews.author: Kimberly
reviews.title: Different, But Not Perfect
reviews.body:
While I do like this mascara overall, I have to disagree with the claims that it is sweat-proof and easy to remove. In my experience, the only reliable way to remove it is with very warm to hot water. Since sweat is essentially warm moisture, I don’t find the sweat-proof claim entirely accurate.

I also find that, especially when applying more than one coat, the water needs to be quite hot and held against the lashes for 10–20 seconds before the product begins to break down and come off completely. Even then, it requires a fair amount of rubbing back and forth to fully remove the mascara. While it is removable without a separate makeup remover, I wouldn’t describe the process as particularly easy or gentle as the marketing suggests.

Another issue is that this formula does not hold up to tears. If you cry, even briefly, it can start coming off quite easily. Given that tears are also a warm liquid, this isn’t particularly surprising, but it does further undermine the product’s claims of being sweat-proof and resistant to moisture.

It’s also worth noting that if you have fine or short lashes, the formula can feel somewhat heavy and cause lashes to lose their curl fairly quickly.

Overall, I do like the product and appreciate many of its qualities, but I feel that some of the marketing claims, particularly regarding sweat resistance and ease of removal, overstate its performance.

I also don’t know how to remove the mascara. These pictures are from today, Monday, after a shower. I applied the ‘mascara’ Friday and Saturday. I’m going to use aquaphor to attempt to soften my lashes and get the product off. 

I like the color a lot I just wish this product behaved more like regular mascara
